title: Beauty of Lyon Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Foliage Colour
description:
Dramatic Colour for Beds, Borders & Containers!
KEY FEATURES
• Striking multicolour foliage with red, purple, orange, and yellow-green
• Colour intensifies in good light for a bold display
• Versatile for containers, borders, and landscape accents
• Sun tolerant and easy to grow, durable performance
• Unique accent colour pairs well with many companions
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'Beauty of Lyon'
Colour: Red, eggplant-purple, orange with yellow-green edges
Season: Foliage interest all season; small summer flowers (usually pinched)
Growth Habit: Shrubby, upright growth pattern
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to partial shade
Soil: Well-draining, fertile soil rich in organic matter
Watering: Moderate; keep soil consistently moist but avoid waterlogging
Spacing: 12-18 inches apart
Height: 12-18 inches (30-45 cm)
Spread: 12-18 inches (30-45 cm)
Hardiness: USDA Zones 10-11 (Tender perennial, often grown as annual)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in spring after the last frost, ensuring soil is warmed to at least 15°C (60°F).
• Pinch back growing tips regularly and remove flower spikes to encourage bushiness and vibrant foliage.
• Water when the top inch of soil feels dry, and mulch to retain moisture.
• Feed container plants with a half-strength balanced liquid fertilizer every 1-2 weeks during the growing season.
• Protect from cold temperatures; bring indoors if temperatures drop below 4°C (40°F).
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
